description.en: Agent presets packaged as a plugin: installing it registers "鲸鱼娘Agent预设", "鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设" and "鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设" (Whale Girl) in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown with no hand-edited config. Each preset is the official minimal composition (shell only) plus file tools, a whale-girl persona and its own persistent memory file, injected as a prompt section so it is read before the first reply.
description.zh: 把 Agent 预设打包成插件：装上就会在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」和「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改配置。每个预设本体是官方极简模式（只开放 shell）+ 文件工具 + 鲸鱼娘人设 + 自己那份持久记忆文件，以提示段形式注入，开口前就已经读过。
